change_reason: User explicitly requests completing the entire training chain, including engineering training, checkpoint reload/resume and self-trained evaluation. Prior data-only acceptance did not complete that responsibility.
scope: Implement B1K-2026 backend training/data/checkpoint interfaces in existing workbench. Preserve all existing jobs and resources; no frontend, other benchmark changes, formal training or V2.2.

mainline.acceptance: Inspect pinned native trainer, sampling/resume semantics and existing training API; retain all live jobs.

Implement explicit episode split materialization for v3 aggregate files, independent video spans and train-only native statistics; verify real-format fixtures without adopting unapproved scientific splits.
Existing training API provides V1.2 preview/start/status/detail/pause/resume with canonical identity, source/weight/data hashes and notes; unknown/unsupported recipes rejected.
Lock explicit test/experiment/run identity and exact engineering recipe before workbench submission; do not infer scientific settings from old 2025 experiments.
Workbench preview/start a <=100-step engineering job from generic N1.7; prove finite real loss/gradients/parameter updates and complete canonical checkpoint.
Pause at optimizer boundary, release resources and continue same run with optimizer/scheduler/RNG/data cursor; verify checkpoint reload and further updates.
Existing evaluation API loads exact self-trained checkpoint and processor, retains task whitelist and writes native JSON/video; report task success separately from runtime completion.
Archive actual jobs/configuration/weights/resume evidence and closed-loop results; enable only capabilities with real evidence.
